items.title: Wim Hof Method
items.description: A powerful breathing technique created by the Ice Man. 30-40 rapid breaths followed by breath retention to boost immunity and energy.

items.title: 4-7-8 Breathing
items.description: A calming technique by Dr. Andrew Weil. Inhale 4 seconds, hold 7 seconds, exhale 8 seconds. Perfect for relaxation and better sleep.

items.question: Do I need an Apple Watch to use BreathWave?
items.answer: No, BreathWave works great on iPhone alone. However, Apple Watch adds real-time heart rate monitoring and haptic guidance for an enhanced experience.

items.question: Is the Wim Hof Method safe?
items.answer: The Wim Hof Method is generally safe for healthy individuals. However, never practice in water or while driving. If you have heart conditions or high blood pressure, consult your doctor first.

items.question: How often should I practice breathing exercises?
items.answer: We recommend starting with one session per day. The Wim Hof Method is best in the morning, while 4-7-8 breathing is perfect before bed or during stressful moments.

items.question: Does BreathWave work offline?
items.answer: Yes! Once downloaded, BreathWave works completely offline on both iPhone and Apple Watch.
